sloka: नाज्ञापयितुमीशो ऽहं युवराजो ऽस्मि यद्यपि ।अयुक्तं कृतकर्माणो यूयं धर्षयितुं मया ।। ५.६४.१५ ।।।।
transliteration: nājñāpayitumīśo 'haṁ yuvarājo 'smi yadyapi ।ayuktaṁ kṛtakarmāṇo yūyaṁ dharṣayituṁ mayā ।। 5.64.15 ।।।।

translations.english: "Even though I am heir apparent, it is not proper for me to order you.You have accomplished the purpose and to command you is not befitting on my part."
